text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in the Moss notes you can see. I've sent you the list with sources in our DM.

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Eau Claire Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting their bay assignments by text when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

The rest of Moss's notes:
- The 9/14 North pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers.
- The ticket numbers in the Central handoffs digest (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to Central accounts.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, and Moss didn't write it.

The Quarrendon Freight Lines account page also lists ticket #4912. It isn't from Moss's notes, so I listed it separately in case you want it. It's still open with support, for lag on the Gate_Dwell_Daily report for Bay 14 check-ins at the Superior yard.
